children: U.S. children's apparel retailer's fiscal Q2 revenue fell 19% yr/yr
Adjusted net loss widened in Q2 as lower traffic and clearance sales weighed on results
Company opened 19 new stores and cut inventory by 23% from prior year
Children's Place plans to build on improved traffic trends into the holiday season
Company remains focused on cost reduction and improving liquidity position
LOWER TRAFFIC & CLEARANCE SALES - Co said Q2 sales decline was driven by lower store and online traffic and a higher proportion of clearance sales
E-COMMERCE TRANSITION ISSUES - Transition of e-commerce operations to Salesforce took longer than anticipated, contributing to sales decline
WHOLESALE SHIPMENT REDUCTION - Planned reduction in wholesale shipments to align inventory positions and liquidate aged inventory weighed on results
HIGHER MARKDOWNS & TARIFFS - Gross margin was pressured by higher markdown sales and increased tariffs, partially offset by tariff refunds
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Children's Place Inc is $3.25, about 33.7% above its September 11 closing price of $2.43
